paper_icpsr_main.description: Paper Table 1 on the ICPSR HIV network: 5 component-level folds, d=3, k=24, gamma=0.99, T=|V|. This original dataset requires an ICPSR user agreement, so this experiment is transcribed as the paper reference but is not the portable scored benchmark.

auc.description: Reference-only area under the cumulative discounted positive-detection curve from the non-redistributable ICPSR experiment.

reward_25pct.description: Reference-only cumulative discounted positive detections after the first 25% of the testing budget.

reward_50pct.description: Reference-only cumulative discounted positive detections after the first 50% of the testing budget.

reward_75pct.description: Reference-only cumulative discounted positive detections after the first 75% of the testing budget.

budget_fraction.description: Reference-only fraction of the allowed testing budget consumed by valid sequential actions.

synthetic_main.description: Portable sequential HIV network testing benchmark on the tracked synthetic forest substitute. This is the scored gym target used when the ICPSR data cannot be redistributed.

auc.description: Area under the cumulative discounted positive-detection curve.

reward_25pct.description: Cumulative discounted positive detections after the first 25% of the testing budget.

reward_50pct.description: Cumulative discounted positive detections after the first 50% of the testing budget.

reward_75pct.description: Cumulative discounted positive detections after the first 75% of the testing budget.

budget_fraction.description: Fraction of the allowed testing budget consumed by valid sequential actions, capped at the paper's full-budget protocol.
